info.name: Benchling AA Sequences Workflow Tasks API

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma separated list of workflow task IDs

params.name: workflowTaskGroupIds
params.description: Comma separated list of workflow IDs

params.name: schemaId
params.description: The ID of the workflow task schema of the workflow task

params.name: statusIds
params.description: Comma separated list of workflow task status ids

params.name: assigneeIds
params.description: Comma separated list of user ids or "null"

params.name: watcherIds
params.description: Comma separated list of user IDs or "null"

params.name: responsibleTeamIds
params.description: Comma separated list of team IDs or "null"

params.name: executionOriginIds
params.description: Comma separated list of entry IDs

params.name: executionTypes
params.description: Comma separated list of workflow execution types. Acceptable execution types are "DIRECT" and "ENTRY"

params.name: linkedItemIds.anyOf
params.description: Comma separated list of bioentity or storable IDs. Maximum of 100. Returns workflow tasks where the task's schema fields reference at least one of the provided items.

params.name: linkedItemIds.allOf
params.description: Comma separated list of bioentity or storable IDs. Returns workflow tasks where the task's schema fields reference all of the provided items.

params.name: linkedItemIds.noneOf
params.description: Comma separated list of bioentity or storable IDs. Returns workflow tasks where the task's schema fields do not reference any of the provided items.

params.name: schemaFields
params.description: Filter based on schema field value (not display value). Restricts results to those with a field whose value matches the filter. For Integer, Float, and Date type fields, supports the >= and <= operators (but not < or >). If any schemaField filters are present, the schemaId param must also be present. Note that all operators must be separated from any values by a single space.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the workflow task

params.name: nameIncludes
params.description: Part of the name of the workflow task

params.name: creatorIds
params.description: Comma separated list of user IDs.

params.name: scheduledOn
params.description: The date on which the task was scheduled to be executed. Returns tasks which are scheduled on the provided date. If "null" is provided returns tasks which are unshceduled.

params.name: scheduledOn.lt
params.description: The date on which the task was scheduled to be executed. Returns tasks which are scheduled before the provided date.

params.name: scheduledOn.lte
params.description: The date on which the task was scheduled to be executed. Returns tasks which are scheduled before or on the provided date.

params.name: scheduledOn.gte
params.description: The date on which the task was scheduled to be executed. Returns tasks which are scheduled on or after the provided date.

params.name: scheduledOn.gt
params.description: The date on which the task was scheduled to be executed. Returns tasks which are scheduled after the provided date.

params.name: modifiedAt
params.description: Datetime, in RFC 3339 format. Supports the > and < operators. Time zone defaults to UTC. Restricts results to those modified in the specified range. e.g. > 2017-04-30. Date ranges can be specified with the following nomenclature > YYYY-MM-DD AND <YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: displayIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of Workflow Task Display IDs.

params.name: archiveReason
params.description: Archive reason. Restricts items to those with the specified archive reason. Use "NOT_ARCHIVED" to filter for unarchived workflow tasks. Use "ANY_ARCHIVED" to filter for archived workflow tasks regardless of reason. Use "ANY_ARCHIVED_OR_NOT_ARCHIVED" to return items for both archived and unarchived.
